["df -h / && sudo du -sh /var/log/agent-platform /var/log/agent-platform/audit 2>/dev/null || true; sudo ls -lah /var/log/agent-platform | sed -n '1,200p'; echo '--- audit ---'; sudo ls -lah /var/log/agent-platform/audit | sed -n '1,200p'", "set -euo pipefail
now=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
base_dir=/var/log/agent-platform
audit_dir=/var/log/agent-platform/audit

printf "Now: %s\n" "$now"

echo "-- Candidates to compress (>7d, *.log, excluding active bases) --"
find "$base_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.log' -mtime +7 \( -not -name 'gateway.log' -and -not -name 'scheduler.log' \) -printf '%TY-%Tm-%Td %TH:%TM %p\n' | sort

echo "-- Candidates to delete (>30d, any files) --"
# Exclude current active base logs just in case
find "$base_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f -mtime +30 \( -not -name 'gateway.log' -and -not -name 'scheduler.log' \) -printf '%s %p\n' | sort -n | awk '{sum+=$1; print $0} END{printf("TOTAL_BYTES %d\n", sum)}'

find "$audit_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f -mtime +30 \( -not -name 'authz.log' \) -printf '%s %p\n' | sort -n | awk '{sum+=$1; print $0} END{printf("TOTAL_BYTES %d\n", sum)}'
", "set -euo pipefail
base_dir=/var/log/agent-platform
audit_dir=/var/log/agent-platform/audit
summary_file="$base_dir/prune-summary-$(date +%Y-%m-%d).txt"

# Find files older than 30 days (excluding current active files)
mapfile -t to_delete < <(find "$base_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f -mtime +30 \( -not -name 'gateway.log' -and -not -name 'scheduler.log' \) -print)
mapfile -t to_delete_audit < <(find "$audit_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f -mtime +30 \( -not -name 'authz.log' \) -print)

# Merge arrays
all_delete=("${to_delete[@]}" "${to_delete_audit[@]}")

# Calculate total size and a concise list of basenames for summary
total_bytes=0
removed_list=()
for f in "${all_delete[@]}"; do
  if [[ -f "$f" ]]; then
    sz=$(stat -c '%s' -- "$f") || sz=0
    total_bytes=$((total_bytes + sz))
    removed_list+=("$(basename -- "$f")")
  fi
done

# Delete files
if (( ${#all_delete[@]} > 0 )); then
  rm -f -- "${all_delete[@]}"
fi

# Compress *.log files older than 7 days but younger than 30 days (skip active current files)
# Base dir
find "$base_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.log' -mtime +7 -mtime -30 \( -not -name 'gateway.log' -and -not -name 'scheduler.log' \) -print0 | xargs -0 -r gzip -9
# Audit dir
find "$audit_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.log' -mtime +7 -mtime -30 \( -not -name 'authz.log' \) -print0 | xargs -0 -r gzip -9

# Run logrotate now for agent-platform
if command -v logrotate >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  logrotate -f /etc/logrotate.d/agent-platform.conf || true
fi

# Prepare one-line summary
count=${#removed_list[@]}
# Format size human readable
hr_size=$(numfmt --to=iec --suffix=B --format='%.1f' "$total_bytes" 2>/dev/null || echo "$total_bytes bytes")
if (( count > 0 )); then
  names=$(IFS=','; echo "${removed_list[*]}")
  echo "Removed $count files totaling $hr_size: $names" | sed 's/,/, /g' | tee "$summary_file"
else
  echo "Removed 0 files totaling 0B" | tee "$summary_file"
fi

# Show resulting disk and dir usage snapshot
{
  echo "--- Disk usage after cleanup ---"
  df -h /
  echo "--- agent-platform dir usage ---"
  du -sh "$base_dir" "$audit_dir" 2>/dev/null || true
  echo "--- Listing agent-platform ---"
  ls -lah "$base_dir" | sed -n '1,200p'
  echo "--- Listing audit ---"
  ls -lah "$audit_dir" | sed -n '1,200p'
  echo "--- Summary file ---"
  cat "$summary_file"
}"]
